goal.description: What the user was trying to achieve, in one sentence, in their own framing.

summary.description: 3-8 sentences: what actually happened, in order. Concrete. No praise, no filler.

projects.description: Repos/directories worked in, absolute paths, most significant first.

decisions.description: Choices made and why — the things that would be expensive to re-derive later.

commands_of_note.description: Reusable commands worth keeping (build, deploy, one-off scripts). Verbatim. Not ls/cat/grep noise.

open_threads.description: Unfinished work, known bugs, explicit TODOs left at the end.

tags.description: 5-10 lowercase keywords for search: tech, domain, activity.

learnings.description: Durable facts discovered about the system/codebase/tooling that were not obvious beforehand. Each must be reusable outside this session.

evidence.description: What in the log shows it: a command, an error, a file.

dead_ends.description: Approaches tried that did not work, and why. The point is to stop a future session repeating them.

user_preferences.description: Preferences or corrections the user stated about how they want work done. Only explicit ones. Candidate CLAUDE.md material.

environment_facts.description: Concrete environment details: versions, install paths, config locations, service names, ports.

next_session_brief.description: 2-4 sentences a fresh agent could start from tomorrow: where things stand and what to do next. Empty string if nothing is pending.
